text:
erin: drafting RN + internal blast for Thurs 09:30 PT deploy. tiny runtime patch but need explicit pin fallback and post-posting rules.
matt: include deploybot id and two paste templates (HOLD / BROADCAST). keep it short.
erin: TL;DR (wip):
- runtime v2.4.6: KV stability + batching perf
- canary: 4% x 20m -> 30% x 20m -> 100%
- no public schema changes
henry: ops guardrail: abort if p95 > 200ms OR 5xx > 0.4% sustained for 5m. fallback: pin to v2.3.5. add CLI snippets.
sre-paul: I'll be oncall. watching 1m p95, 5xx, queue depth. escalate if p95>200ms. set alert for GPU util >85% over 3m.
deploybot: "scheduled deploy id dx-20250320-9 by erin at 2025-03-20T16:30:00Z (09:30 PT). canary policy: 4%->30%->100%. notify: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime"
matt: rollback snippet for RN:
```
# abort and fallback
deploybot cancel --id dx-20250320-9 --reason "canary regression"
# console pin fallback (UI steps)
Console > Model > v2.3.5 > Actions > Pin to traffic
```
erin: announce templates ready. poster checklist: 1) confirm canary metrics OK for 20m; 2) post BROADCAST to #eng-releases + #all-hands at T+5m if OK; 3) update deploy ticket with RN link; 4) close ticket.
sre-paul: I'll post preflight OK 15m before. If rollback happens I'll post status updates and confirm pin action.
erin: publishing draft for quick review. please ack so i can attach to the runbook and lock the deploy ticket.
matt: ack, looks good. henry: ack from ops.
erin: thanks everyone ":thumbsup:" — reconvene 10m before window for final go/no-go.
